guard: an isolated worker can die without taking the custodial child PID with it, and a successor can adopt the surviving seat
why: The fixture launches a real detached custodian, records worker and child pids, kills only the worker, then adopts the surviving seat. Both mutation windows are code-only unique anchors.

mutations.name: M1 suppress worker-death survival
mutations.expectRed: worker death leaves the custodial child PID running
mutations.cell: worker death leaves the custodial child PID running
mutations.note: The mutation is only the final child-live predicate after the worker is proven dead.
